maddeler.e:
أستحوش (form X)
# أَسْتَحْوِشُ (ʔastaḥwišu) /ʔas.taħ.wi.ʃu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْوَشَ (istaḥwaša)
# أَسْتَحْوِشَ (ʔastaḥwiša) /ʔas.taħ.wi.ʃa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَحْوَشَ (istaḥwaša)
# أَسْتَحْوِشْ (ʔastaḥwiš) /ʔas.taħ.wiʃ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَحْوَشَ (istaḥwaša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
